content.value_statement: Engineering teams lose rationale when choices stay only in code review. The Archivist helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create ADRs, decision logs, and inline rationale.
actual_capabilities: Detects engineering choices that should be documented based on impact and reversibility.
Classifies decisions into inline comments, decision log entries, or full ADRs.
Provides templates for ADRs, decision logs, quick Y-statements, and review comments.
Defines review and verification checklists for missing decision rationale.
Explains when formal documentation is unnecessary to reduce process overhead.
limitations: Does not write or run application code by itself; it guides decision documentation.
Does not validate whether an architecture choice is technically correct.
Requires the user or agent to maintain project decision files.
Examples assume Markdown decision records can be stored in the repository.

use_cases.title: Capture architecture choices
use_cases.description: Document why a team selected one technology, pattern, or dependency over reasonable alternatives.

use_cases.title: Review missing rationale
use_cases.description: Check pull requests for non-obvious decisions that need inline comments or ADR links.

use_cases.title: Standardize project memory
use_cases.description: Create a consistent decision log so future maintainers understand historical trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Document a Choice
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for one implementation decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me document this engineering choice. Identify the decision, the reason, one rejected alternative, and the right documentation tier.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Brief ADR
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a moderate feature decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this implementation choice into a brief ADR entry with context, decision, rationale, rejected alternatives, consequences, and status.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Pull Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for code review support.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these changes for undocumented engineering decisions. List each missing rationale item and recommend inline comment, decision log, or full ADR.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Decision History
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for repository documentation maintenance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this project history for decisions that need ADRs. Group findings by documentation tier and suggest updates to the decision log.

output_examples.input: I chose PostgreSQL over MongoDB for reporting queries.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend a full ADR with context, selected option, rejected alternatives, query needs, operational impact, and consequences.

output_examples.input: A reviewer sees custom retry logic without any explanation.
output_examples.output: The skill would flag missing rationale and suggest an inline comment or brief decision entry explaining why a library was not used.

output_examples.input: A team adds a job queue dependency for background processing.
output_examples.output: The skill would classify it as a major decision and request a complete ADR before implementation proceeds.

best_practices: Record the decision before implementation when the choice affects future maintenance.
Include rejected alternatives and consequences, not only the selected option.
Link code, plans, and ADRs so future readers can trace rationale.
anti_patterns: Creating ADRs after implementation only to justify choices already made.
Writing vague comments that state preference without explaining alternatives.
Documenting trivial choices that do not affect maintainability or architecture.

faq.question: What does The Archivist help document?
faq.answer: It helps document engineering decisions, rejected alternatives, trade-offs, and links between code and ADRs.

faq.question: Does it create full Architecture Decision Records?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a full ADR template and guidance for when a full record is appropriate.

faq.question: Can it be used during code review?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides checklist items and review responses for missing decision documentation.

faq.question: Will it document every small choice?
faq.answer: No. It includes rules for avoiding unnecessary documentation of trivial or conventional choices.

faq.question: Does it replace technical judgment?
faq.answer: No. It records the rationale for a decision, but it does not prove the decision is correct.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
